def solve_cov(K, y0, pen=0.03, maxiter=100):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_factor
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    n = len(y0)
    I = np.eye(n)
    m = len(K)
    KF = K.reshape(m, -1)
    norm = max(np.std(y0), 0.01)
    y0 = y0 / norm

    def loss(s):
        w = np.exp(s)
        A = (w @ KF).reshape(n, n)
        A.flat[::n + 1] += 1e-08
        f = cho_factor(A, check_finite=False)
        u = cho_solve(f, y0, check_finite=False)
        inv = cho_solve(f, I, check_finite=False)
        Q = inv - np.outer(u, u)
        return (0.5 * (y0 @ u + 2 * np.log(f[0].diagonal()).sum()) + pen * np.sum(w), w * (0.5 * (KF @ Q.ravel()) + pen))
    st = np.full(m, -np.log(m))
    st[0] = 0
    st[-1] = -4
    r = minimize(loss, st, jac=True, method='L-BFGS-B', bounds=[(-16, 5)] * m, options={'maxiter': maxiter, 'ftol': 1e-08})
    return np.exp(r.x)
